context: A boss reviews a CSR report
purpose: Teach: 無償/基調/結ば/保っ/欠ける/とらえる/所見/判っ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: CSR報告、無償活動の章、基調を保って書けているか。
lines.en: CSR report—the volunteering chapter. Is the tone consistent throughout?
lines.style: Clipped, efficient. Leans forward slightly. Questions have weight without irritation. Eyes tracking for the answer before it comes.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。実態をとらえる例も結ばれ、説得力があります。
lines.en: Yes. The examples ground it in reality, and it reads convincingly.
lines.style: Steady, competent. No flourish. Reports facts with understated confidence. Meets his eye level without overstepping.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 欠ける数値、補強しろ。所見欄も、簡潔に。
lines.en: Fill in the missing figures. And tighten up the remarks section.
lines.style: Crisp instruction, no preamble. Light stress on the action words. Not unkind—the efficiency of someone who knows what works. Expects compliance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 監査側、内容を判って好評を頂きました。
lines.en: The auditors understood the material and gave positive feedback.
lines.style: Factual update, slight lift at the end. Understands this is good news without overselling it. Waits for his next move.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: よし、年次報告に向けて。
lines.en: Good. Now we move toward the annual report.
lines.style: Settled, forward-looking. A nod closing one phase. Quiet authority—the next steps are already in motion in his mind.
